decision_rules.full_ladder: At least one evidence-backed material change is true and the proposed population is training-eligible.
decision_rules.focused_only: No evidence-backed material change is true, or the new population remains candidate-only.

actions.FULL_LADDER_RETRAINING_ADMITTED: Run the complete preliminary ladder at the coherent milestone.
actions.FOCUSED_INTEGRATION_REPLAY_ONLY: Run focused joins, replay, serialization, leakage, and provenance tests.
actions.REJECT_INVALID_EVIDENCE: Quarantine the decision until identities and observed deltas validate.
